research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 12436 of July 29, 1983, 48 FR 34931, held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12436.txt; it designates the Administrator of Veterans' Affairs to administer section 156 of Public Law 97-377 (benefits to survivors of persons who died in or as a result of military service), directs HHS support with reimbursement, and directs the Secretary of Defense to transfer from the Retired Pay, Defense account in fiscal year 1983 and each succeeding fiscal year; effective January 1, 1983. The order's heading is not in the clause envelope; the held text begins at section 1 and the four section clauses cover all of the numbered text (sec. 4 effective date included). Searches of held texts for the number find the 1989 OFR codification line and a Veterans Affairs information-collection notice (83 FR 584, Jan. 4, 2018) citing the order as directing VA to administer section 156. No amendment, revocation or supersession is held or catalogued (OFR catalog: no note). Authority statute: section 156 of Pub. L. 97-377 is printed in the held current Code (42 U.S.C. 402 note) as amended in 1983, 1988 and 1991 with no repeal or expiry language. Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
